events.title: European Shares Poised For Lower Open Amid Debt Concerns
events.description: European stocks look set to open lower on Tuesday as investors fret over rising debt levels in Europe and tightening financial conditions.

events.title: Australian Market Maintains Early Losses In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian stock market is maintaining its early losses in mid-market trading on Tuesday, reversing some of the gains in the previous two sessions, following the mixed cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 index is falling below the 8,800 level, with weakness across most sectors led by mining and financial stocks.

events.title: Asian Markets Trade Mostly Lower
events.description: Asian stock markets are mostly lower on Tuesday, following the mixed cues from Wall Street overnight, as elevated crude oil prices amid ongoing hostilities in the Middle East and Eastern Europe, heightened global inflation concerns and pushed global yields higher. Iran continues to assert its control over the Strait of Hormuz, with ships being attacked more frequently than at any point in the war.

events.title: Indian Stock Markets Shut For Dussehra
events.description:
Indian stock markets remain closed today on account of Dussehra. Benchmark indexes Sensex and Nifty fell over 1 percent each on Monday due to concerns over persistent foreign investor outflows and elevated crude oil prices in international markets. 
Investors also assessed September-quarter earnings from prominent private banks.

events.title: Thai Shares May Find Traction On Tuesday
events.description: The Thai stock market has finished lower in back-to-back sessions, sinking almost 5 points or 0.3 percent in that span. The Stock Exchange of Thailand now sits just above the 1,570-point plateau although it may stop the bleeding on Tuesday.

events.title: Indonesia Stock Market Overdue For Support On Tuesday
events.description: The Indonesia stock market has finished lower in three straight sessions, crashing more than 950 points or 16.6 percent in that span. The Jakarta Composite Index now sits just beneath the 5,000-point plateau although it has a positive lead again for Tuesday's trade.

events.title: Japanese Market Sharply Lower
events.description: The Japanese stock market is trading sharply lower on Tuesday, extending the losses in the previous session, following the mixed cues from Wall Street overnight, with the Nikkei 225 falling well below the 64,150 level, with weakness in index heavyweights and financial stocks.

events.title: Higher Open Seen For Hong Kong Stock Market
events.description: Ahead of Monday's holiday for Chung Yeung Day, the Hong Kong stock market had ended the two-day slide in which it had dropped more than 280 points or 1.2 percent. The Hang Seng now sits just above the 24,180-point plateau and it may open to the upside again on Tuesday.

events.title: Australian Markets Significantly Lower
events.description: The Australian stock market is significantly lower on Tuesday, reversing some of the gains in the previous two sessions, following the mixed cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 index is falling well below the 8,800 level, with weakness across most sectors led by mining and financial stocks.

events.title: China Stock Market May Extend Winning Streak
events.description: The China stock market has finished higher in two straight sessions, gathering almost 25 points or 0.8 percent in that span. The Shanghai Composite Index now sits just above the 3,730-point plateau and it may add to its winnings on Tuesday.

events.title: Taiwan Stock Market May Stop The Bleeding On Tuesday
events.description: The Taiwan stock market has alternated between positive and negative finishes through the last four trading days since the end of the four-day losing streak in which it had dropped almost 1,500 points or 3.1 percent. The Taiwan Stock Exchange now sits just above the 46,820-point plateau although it may find support on Tuesday.

events.title: Singapore Stock Market May Reverse Monday's Losses
events.description: The Singapore stock market ticked lower again on Monday, one session after ending the two-day slide in which it had fallen almost 30 points or 0.6 percent. The STI now sits just above the 5,410-point plateau although it figures to rebound again on Tuesday.

events.title: Malaysia Stock Market May Halt Its Slide
events.description: The Malaysia stock market has finished lower in three straight sessions, slumping more than 30 points or 2 percent in that span. The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index now sits just shy of the 1,600-point plateau although it may find traction on Tuesday.
